AQI TOWER · MECHANICAL STUDY · 02 OCT 2026

A frame that carries the parts

The outer casing is separate from the supports. This sheet shows an assumed route, not metal sizes to order or a safe-to-build drawing.

Eight real CAD clashes found. Four posts cross both filter plates. Holes or open hollow tubes could let dirty air bypass the HEPA. A reviewed support-and-seal interface is required; do not cut holes from this drawing.

What passed: twenty valid route solids; FreeCAD reopen and STEP reimport; nominal clearance from checked component envelopes and the assumed HEPA removal sweep.

Still unknown: approved member sizes, joints, fan mounts, complete weight/centre of gravity, strength, tipping/sliding, installed leakage and outdoor anchoring. The assumed 35 × 35 × 3 mm steel routes add about 47.75 kg before base and hardware.

Illustration simplifies the elevation; dimensions are routing assumptions only. See M02_FRAME_INTERFACES.md and M02_FRAME_ROUTING_AUDIT.json. NOT FOR FABRICATION.
